extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors/editors (especially new users attempting to create a page)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating a new Wikipedia article/page, including prerequisites, checks to perform before creation, and procedural alternatives like drafts or requests. Aimed at users who encounter a 'no article with this exact name' message.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Bohemian Rhapsody SNL" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new article, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling. Use Wikipedia search and consider alternative capitalizations and redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New users cannot create pages until they meet the autoconfirmed criteria (account age and/or edit count). If you cannot create a page, log in or build your account to meet autoconfirmed status first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack privileges to create a live article or want feedback before publishing, create a draft via the article wizard or request an article through the appropriate review/request processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the desired title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to find existing pages that reference the topic; that can reveal where content exists or whether a redirect is more appropriate than a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for recent-creation visibility delays / purge cache
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating or assuming a page doesn't exist, consider replication/update delays. Use the purge function or wait briefly to confirm visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check capitalization and consider adding redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm the exact title case; if your title differs only by capitalization or minor variants, create or request a redirect rather than a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log before recreating a page
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate deletion history to understand why a page was removed before attempting to recreate it; addressing deletion reasons (notability, sourcing, etc.) is necessary for successful creation.
